newsitem.title: USA: Newfield boosts capital spending budget.
newsitem.headline: Newfield boosts capital spending budget.

text.p: Newfield Exploration Co has increased its capital budget and production targets for this year.
The company said in a statement with earnings that it would spend $211 million, up from an initial target of $129 million and a revised $173.3 million.
Newfileld said that it would produce 72 billion cubic feet (bcf) of natural gas this year, having initially targeted a 20 percent increase of 1996's 56.7 billion cubic feet equivalent.

"We are currently concluding capital programs at West Delta 152 and Vermilion 398, and installing a platform at West Cameron 560, and will bring these facilities to full rate in the third quarter," said Joe Foster, the company's chief executive.

For the six months of this year, oil and gas production rose 27 percent to 34.0 billion cubic feet of natural gas and capital spending was $113.7 million. ((-- David Chance New York Newsroom 212 859 1902))
